name: Glubokoe Chtivo
source: After getting into "Sovenok", Semyon discovered that he has a superpower - as soon as he starts reading a book, he is immediately transported into the world of the work and becomes its protagonist. How will our hero control his power? Will he be able to return to his native world with its help?
translation: 进入《索维诺克》后，谢苗发现自己拥有一种超能力——只要他开始阅读一本书，他就会立即进入作品的世界，成为其中的主角。我们的英雄将如何控制他的力量？在它的帮助下，他能否回到自己的世界呢？
